## About
Pit Auto Repair is a neighborhood car repair shop on Malyn Blvd in Fraser. We handle everything from AC and heat repair, brakes and oil changes to diagnostics, suspension, steering, exhaust, and full engine and transmission work. Domestic, European or Asian, bring it in.
Our customers have given us a 5 rating across 28 Google reviews. A reviewer said we explained everything clearly and finished the repair on time. Another called us a trustworthy business. That is how we want every visit to feel.

## Services
- Brakes and oil: Everyday maintenance at a fair price, as a reviewer put it.
- Engine rebuild and replace: When the engine needs real work, we can rebuild it or replace it.
- Transmission rebuild and repair: Full transmission rebuilds and repairs.
- Exhaust system repair: Leaks, rattles and worn exhaust parts fixed.

## FAQ
Q: What kinds of cars do you work on?
A: Domestic, European and Asian models. We fix them all.

Q: When are you open?
A: We are open Monday to Saturday and closed on Sunday.

Q: How do I schedule an appointment?
A: Contact us and we will get you on the schedule.
